title: On-demand Attestation Packs: pricing pilot for mid-market customers
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Mid-market and high-growth customers routinely ask for short-form signed security attestations and CAIQ-lite answers during procurement. Full SIG/CAIQ compilations are costly to assemble and slow down close rates. Goal: ship an on-demand 'Attestation Pack' product that bundles a curated set of signed answers, a one-page compliance summary, and optional delta evidence (if requested) — priced and delivered as a self-serve add-on or sales-triggered credit.

Scope: prototype pricing experiment and operational flow for two variants: 'Lite Pack' (self-serve, fixed price, automated generation from answers library) and 'Fast Path' (sales-assisted, includes 30 minutes of SE support & signed PDF). Work includes: mapping existing CAIQ answers to a minimal, high-value subset; building an attestation generator endpoint (backend); legal-approved signed template; UI for Console purchase & evidence download; audit logging for Private/Dedicated customers.

Metrics / Success criteria:
- Reduction in average sales cycle days for target cohort by at least 20% within pilot (tracked per opportunity tags).
- 50 paid Lite Pack purchases in pilot window (8 weeks) OR 10 Fast Path conversions.
- Time to assemble attestation: target < 15 minutes (automated) vs current manual > 3 days.
- NPS/CSAT for onboarding touches >= 4.0 for customers who used packs.

Experiment design (pricing):
- Variant A (self-serve Lite): $750 one-time for up to 3 attestations, renewable per quarter.
- Variant B (Fast Path): $2,500 one-time includes signed artifact + SE 30m + expedited evidence pull.
- Track conversion funnels, refund requests, number of follow-up evidence requests.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console shows purchasable Lite Pack for eligible accounts (billing hooks wired).
- Attestation generator produces canonical signed PDF and a machine-readable JSON CAIQ-lite export.
- Audit log entry created for every generated pack and stored in customer activity stream.
- Legal & Security sign-off on templates and persona-based risk matrix.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Customers will still ask for full SIG/CAIQ despite pack; Mitigation: add 'upgrade to full SIG' upsell and require pack to include clear scope & disclaimers.
- Risk: Operational load from evidence requests; Mitigation: limit Lite Pack to curated answers and bundle paid Fast Path for deeper pulls.

Rollout plan:
1) 2-week design & legal discovery (deliver templates + mapping)
2) 3-week engineering build (generator endpoint + billing integration)
3) Pilot enablement (select 30 mid-market accounts; sales notified)
4) 8-week observation window + metrics analysis

Notes: this ticket focuses on packaging & pricing experiment; separate ENG tickets handle heavy automation for evidence assembly and signed KMS integrations (ENG-21345).
